| w2-agent-core follow-up 34 | r19 M-2 is production-reachable: after a due renewal signs lease h, a busy Apply lock (`nodelock` ErrBusy after three 50 ms attempts) leaves g installed and serving, and the end-of-Step report sent an ACK of g carrying h's live refs. Fixed: the agent keeps a minimal applied snapshot (generation, binding revision, policy refs), committed atomically with the ACK in the existing metadata table and reported only when it matches the applied generation; restart-safe, unknown legacy refs stay null, frozen identities still suppress them. No central classification reads these refs. r19 L-2 fixed: a conntrack delete batch's count and identities are reserved in one transaction before Apply; a crash or a pre-delete failure consumes the reservation, generation changes keep pending accounting, and the 12-attempt bound is unchanged. The write costs about 1.1 ms (p99 1.59 ms) before the restricting install on Steps with queued deletes; same-host A,B,A,B 12 / 12 pass with 6 qualified legs, judged under D-138: no B-only failure, no attributable regression, cost explicit. r19's production proofs adopted (two converted: failing on `main`, passing here; eight design-only proofs dropped per D-141). 2 requests (isolation and members timelines). | done (#388) |
